Keep the person's recognizable facial structure, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, hairline and hair characteristics, and their apparent adult age. Do not copy the clothing, background, pose or lighting from the reference. A night photograph of a {argument name="setting" default="city square"}. The flat side wall of a {argument name="building type" default="six storey brick building"} fills most of the frame. A projector on a rooftop opposite throws an enormous portrait of the adult woman onto that wall: head and shoulders, roughly four storeys tall, three quarter view, calm expression, eyes looking slightly down and to the left as if she is watching the square below. The projected portrait behaves like light on brick, not like a printed poster. It dims and warps where it crosses window recesses, a drainpipe and a fire escape. It breaks and skips across the mortar lines. Its edges fall off softly at the corners of the wall. There is a slight keystone distortion because the projector is not level with the wall. Down on the pavement at the bottom of the frame, small, the same adult woman stands with her back three quarters to the camera, hands in the pockets of a {argument name="outfit" default="long dark coat"}, head tilted up, looking at her own projected face. She is about one fifteenth the height of the projected head. Environment: wet paving stones, a bicycle chained to a post, a closed kiosk, one other pedestrian walking out of frame, a bus stop sign, the glow of a street lamp. Camera: standing on the pavement about twenty five metres back, phone at chest height tilted slightly up, vertical 9:16 frame, the building filling the top three quarters and the small figure placed low and left of centre. Light: the projector is the brightest thing in the scene. Cold street lamps and a red traffic signal reflecting in the wet stone. Her small figure is lit only by projector spill and street lamp, so her face is barely readable and that is correct. Realism: dust and haze visible in the projector beam high above, brick texture showing through the projected image, slight flicker banding, a soft blue night sky with no stars, grain in the shadows. The projection must read as light thrown onto a rough wall, not as a poster stuck to it. The large projected face must clearly be the same person as the small figure below. Do not add a second projected image. Do not clean the wall.

items.title: Academic Realism Mixed Media Portrait
items.prompt: Subject and Pose: Create an illustration that is 100% faithful to the {argument name="reference" default="attached reference portrait"}, maintaining the exact likeness, pose, and expression. Combine oil painting techniques for dramatic modeling and bright, subtle color washes with classic charcoal realism and expressive cross-hatching for structure and shadow. Ensure the drawing is museum-quality and highly polished. Picture Elements: Layer the artwork with fine, visible pencil strokes, detailed ink sketches, technical sketch marks, and observational drawing techniques (e.g., proportion lines, texture studies) across the canvas, displaying academic precision. Color Palette: Limit colors to a sophisticated mix: warm earth tones and rich sepia graphite for shadow and structure, contrasted with {argument name="style" default="soft, delicate oil pastel strokes"} that match the colors of the attached subject. The general background should be a rich, dark sepia tone with charcoal, with exterior scenes in soft pencil lines and pastel washes. Presentation: Use a {argument name="texture" default="textured oil canvas"} as the base. Balance scientific rigor with artistic expression, featuring elegant negative space and atmospheric depth. The presentation should be an editorial fine art portfolio, visualizing both classic academic imagery and contemporary conceptual portraiture. Restrictions: Avoid cartoonish styles, comic book styles, digital plastic renderings, text, and glossy CGI. The aspect ratio should be 9:16.

items.title: Moody Cinematic Suit Portrait
items.prompt: A young man in a {argument name="suit color" default="dark navy-black"}, relaxed-fit suit with a wide-collar striped shirt left unbuttoned leans with shifted weight and relaxed shoulders, facing the camera with his hands resting out of sight in his jacket pockets. His hair is cut short above the ears in a relaxed push-back style, displaying a natural wavy texture, matte finish, visible flyaways, a deep natural part, and organic growth patterns. His serious, deliberately posed expression features relaxed eyebrows and a neutral mouth as he casts a quiet, melancholic gaze away from the viewer. He stands in a deep, historic indoor space, positioned off-center left against a {argument name="wall texture" default="weathered, warm gray plaster wall"} characterized by a matte, slightly textured painted finish, patchy faded reddish and greenish faux-paneling borders, and visible scuffs. In the foreground to his left, a worn dark wood staircase banister with wrought iron balusters leads the eye, while a striking, heavily worn black and white checkered tile landing dominates the bottom right, counterbalancing his visual weight. In the upper right background, a large vintage mirror reflects a deep stone staircase extending upward. The mysterious, reflective atmosphere is shaped by warm, golden, soft mixed lighting diffused smoothly from overhead ambient sources and a weak frontal fill, casting short, soft-edged gray shadows onto the wall behind him and beneath the banister rails. Preserved highlights gently illuminate his face, his white shirt collar, and the brighter floor tiles, accentuating a high-contrast but heavily desaturated palette of aged beige, faded red, off-white, and dark navy. Captured from a high-angle perspective using a 35mm lens at f/4.0, 1/125s, and ISO 800, this realistic editorial photograph evokes European cinema and moody romanticism through a deep depth of field, slightly soft sharpness, and authentic film grain, finalized with lifted blacks, a warm shadow tint, and reduced clarity for a faded historic grandeur, ultimately framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
